Mina / Naomi / Caleb —

Procurement is OK with a voice OTP + bank statement as a conditional path for PO activation in this case, provided Finance performs the OTP and we capture the verification artifact in the vendor record. Proposed steps:

- Redwood to run a one‑time voice OTP to Lumen’s CFO (Caleb to confirm name/phone this AM).
- CFO reads back a short code; Redwood records the date/time and operator name.
- Lumen uploads a redacted bank statement (last 4 digits + bank name + dated within 60 days).
- Finance confirms the last 4 digits match the account on file when ACH is submitted.
- Procurement issues provisional PO (PO-10472-PROV) with conditional payment hold until verification is in the record. Once Finance approves, PO changes to active and procurement removes the hold.

I attached a short doc with the voice OTP script and logging fields we use (voice-otp-instructions.docx). Caleb — please share CFO contact and availability and we’ll schedule the call for today.

If Finance objects, escalate and we can request a scanned notarized bank letter.

— Marcus
Senior Procurement Specialist | Redwood Inference
Attachment: voice-otp-instructions.docx
HubSpot: https://hubspot.redwood/in/contacts/LS-48217
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: W-9 attached + onboarding note

Thanks — I reviewed the proposed conditional path. Finance will accept the voice OTP + redacted bank statement as sufficient evidence to clear the PO hold, with these constraints:

- OTP must be recorded (operator name + timestamp).
- Redacted bank statement must show payee name and bank routing/last4 (we permit last 4 only in shared copy).
- Lumen must provide ACH remittance information in CSV (template attached) but Finance will not process payments until the verification artifacts are stored in our vendor file.
- Once we confirm artifacts, Finance will flip PO-10472-PROV to an active PO (expected same business day if OTP completed before 3pm PT).

Caleb — please reply with the CFO's name and phone and upload the bank statement to the Drive folder: https://drive.redwood.com/teams/procurement/lumen-onboarding/ (set folder to vendor-only). We will then schedule the OTP and notify you when the PO is live.

Naomi Feldman
Director, Accounts Payable | Redwood Inference
